name: A house without the family-time cap does not inherit it

statusDetails.message: House family-times had family cap 1; created house B without that cap and confirmed two family occurrences for its household 12.

labels.value: A cap counts only bookings in its configured class

steps.name: Given house A caps its family-time class at one active or upcoming booking
And house B has not configured that cap
When an eligible house B household requests a free family-time window
Then house A's cap is not used to decide the house B request
